score_breakdown.name: legal_accuracy
score_breakdown.rationale: Computed from overlap between expected legal points and final answer.

score_breakdown.name: coverage
score_breakdown.rationale: Computed from overlap between expected legal points and transcript.

score_breakdown.name: clarity
score_breakdown.rationale: Shorter, well-bounded conclusions receive higher clarity.

score_breakdown.name: risk_awareness
score_breakdown.rationale: Checks whether caveats or next-step guidance is present.

score_breakdown.name: human_likeness
score_breakdown.rationale: Measures whether the conversation mirrors realistic lawyer-client intake behavior.

score_breakdown.name: contract_alignment
score_breakdown.rationale: Measures overlap between generated contract and reference Slovak rental templates.

4) Najomne: 850 EUR mesacne, splatne do 5. dna v mesiaci.
5) Platba vopred: 2 mesacne najomne vopred.
